figs.name: open-loop-and-closed-loop-control-system-block-diagram
figs.alt: open loop and closed loop control system block diagram with heater, process and feedback
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing open loop and closed loop temperature control: setpoint, controller, heater and tank, with a transmitter feeding back to the error detector.
figs.after_h2: What is a Closed Loop Control System?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<text x="425.0" y="145.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">final element</text>
<rect x="525" y="95" width="140" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="122.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process</text>
<text x="595.0" y="145.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">tank</text>

<line x1="665" y1="128" x2="775" y2="128" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="720" y="116" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<text x="400" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">No feedback: the output is never measured</text>
<line x1="20" y1="222" x2="780" y2="222" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="20" y="255" font-size="20" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Closed loop</text>
<rect x="20" y="300" width="110" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="75.0" y="327.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Setpoint</text>
<text x="75.0" y="350.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">60 °C</text>
<circle cx="175" cy="333" r="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="161" y1="333" x2="189" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>

<text x="150" y="318" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
<text x="195" y="372" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">−</text>

<text x="290.0" y="327.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Controller</text>
<text x="290.0" y="350.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">PID</text>
<rect x="390" y="300" width="120" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="450.0" y="327.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Heater</text>
<text x="450.0" y="350.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">final element</text>
<rect x="545" y="300" width="130" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="327.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process</text>

<line x1="130" y1="333" x2="153" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="195" y1="333" x2="223" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="355" y1="333" x2="388" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="510" y1="333" x2="543" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="675" y1="333" x2="775" y2="333" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="735" y="321" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<line x1="610" y1="272" x2="610" y2="298" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="610" y="262" font-size="17" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cold inflow disturbance</text>
<rect x="420" y="410" width="220" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="530.0" y="434.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Temperature</text>

<text x="300" y="465" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Feedback</text>
<text x="400" y="515" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">The error detector compares the measured output with the setpoint.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: open-loop-and-closed-loop-control-system-temperature-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of automatic room temperature control using a sensor, set point and heater feedback
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing automatic room temperature control: the sensor measures, the heater turns on below set point and off at the desired value.
figs.after_h2: What are different Types of Control Systems
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of automatic room temperature control with sensor feedback</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Automatic Room Temperature Control</text>
<rect x="200" y="60" width="400" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="96.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor measures room temperature</text>
<line x1="400" y1="120" x2="400" y2="143" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,145.0 530.0,205 400,265.0 270.0,205" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="200.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Below the</text>
<text x="400" y="222.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">set point?</text>
<line x1="270" y1="205" x2="212" y2="205" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="241" y="193" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="30" y="175" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Heater</text>
<text x="120.0" y="223.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">turns ON</text>
<line x1="530" y1="205" x2="558" y2="205" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="543" y="193" font-size="17" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="560" y="175" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650.0" y="199.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Heater turns OFF</text>
<text x="650.0" y="222.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at desired value</text>
<polyline points="120,235 120,355 168,355" fill="none" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="650,235 650,355 632,355" fill="none" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="170" y="320" width="460" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="349.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Controller acts on the error</text>
<text x="400.0" y="372.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">error = set point minus actual temperature</text>
<line x1="400" y1="390" x2="400" y2="428" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="430" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="466.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor keeps measuring</text>
<polyline points="550,460 765,460 765,90 602,90" fill="none" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="755" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#db2777" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Feedback</text>
<text x="400" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Measuring and correcting the error makes this a closed loop system</text>
</svg>

figs.name: open-loop-and-closed-loop-control-system-comparison-chart
figs.alt: comparison chart of open loop and closed loop systems by feedback, accuracy, stability and cost
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing open loop and closed loop control systems on feedback, accuracy, disturbances, stability, cost, bandwidth and examples.
figs.after_h2: Comparision of Open Loop vs Closed Loop
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 570" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Comparison chart of open loop and closed loop control systems</title>
<rect width="800" height="570" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Open Loop vs Closed Loop at a Glance</text>
<rect x="20" y="55" width="760" height="46" rx="0" fill="#db2777" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="0"/>
<text x="120.0" y="85" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Point</text>
<text x="365.0" y="85" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Open loop</text>
<text x="645.0" y="85" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Closed loop</text>
<rect x="20" y="101" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="137" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Feedback</text>
<text x="365.0" y="137" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">None, output not measured</text>
<text x="645.0" y="137" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Sensor measures output</text>
<rect x="20" y="159" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="195" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Accuracy</text>
<text x="365.0" y="195" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Low</text>
<text x="645.0" y="195" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">High</text>
<rect x="20" y="217" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="253" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Disturbances</text>
<text x="365.0" y="253" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Not corrected</text>
<text x="645.0" y="253" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Corrected automatically</text>
<rect x="20" y="275" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="311" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Stability</text>
<text x="365.0" y="311" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Always stable</text>
<text x="645.0" y="311" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Can oscillate if badly tuned</text>
<rect x="20" y="333" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="369" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cost</text>
<text x="365.0" y="369" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Simple and cheap</text>
<text x="645.0" y="369" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">More parts, needs tuning</text>
<rect x="20" y="391" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="427" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Bandwidth</text>
<text x="365.0" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Small</text>
<text x="645.0" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Large</text>
<rect x="20" y="449" width="760" height="58" rx="0" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="120.0" y="485" font-size="18" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Examples</text>
<text x="365.0" y="485" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Toaster, traffic light</text>
<text x="645.0" y="485" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">AC thermostat, cruise control</text>
<line x1="220" y1="101" x2="220" y2="507" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<line x1="510" y1="101" x2="510" y2="507" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="400" y="545" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Adding a sensor and feedback turns an open loop into a closed loop</text>
</svg>
